verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a credit-metered hosted scraping service, so spending caps and usage alerts are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents a spending cap, credit limit, or usage alert. The nearby controls, per-key format/endpoint locks and IP allowlists ([firecrawl-docs-17], [firecrawl-docs-18]) and job-lifecycle webhooks ([firecrawl-docs-11]), restrict access or report job progress, not budget consumption.
